description: Decoder-limit vectors for wire-v0 section 6: each limit just at and just past its bound, under the default limits unless a vector carries `limits` (merged over the defaults). Hex is body bytes only. `plan` selects row@1 or columnar@5. Decoders and encoders both run them.

valid.name: amplification-at-bound
valid.description: 32 zero-payload rows with no bytes after the count: exactly maxAmplification x (0 + 1)

valid.name: col-amplification-at-bound
valid.description: 128 rows of a width-zero column: 3 bytes follow the count, 32 x (3 + 1) = 128

valid.name: budget-nested-at-bound
valid.description: 64 inner arrays of 32 rows each pass their own bound; the counts sum to 64 + 64 x 32 = 2112 = 32 x (65 + 1)

valid.name: budget-fixed-at-bound
valid.description: fixed lengths are charged too: 2 + 2 x 15 = 32 items in an empty body

invalidDecode.name: budget-nested-over-bound
invalidDecode.description: 65 inner arrays of 32 rows: every count passes its own bound, but the sum 65 + 65 x 32 = 2145 exceeds 32 x (66 + 1) = 2144

invalidDecode.name: budget-fixed-over-bound
invalidDecode.description: 2 + 2 x 16 = 34 items in an empty body; each fixed length alone is within 32
